win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: DOLLAR-REELS
wilds.behavior:
When a Danny symbol lands it expands into a Wild Dollar-Reel if the expanded symbol is a part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Danny symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid. Danny symbols that do not expand are counted as a single Wild symbol. Only one Danny symbol can land on a reel at a time. Expanded Dollar-Reels count as Wilds on every position the expanded symbol covers.

 If a Dollar-Reel expands through a Wild symbol a multiplier is applied to the entire Dollar-Reel. Dollar-Reel Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

 If a winning combination includes more than one Dollar-Reel with a multiplier, the multiplier values will be added together and then applied to the win.

specials.name: NUDGE SYMBOL
specials.behavior: If there are Nudge symbols on the grid they will activate after all Dollar-Reels have expanded. Once activated, they nudge all Dollar-Reels on the current grid downwards, extending the Dollar-Reels by one row.

modes.name: DOLLAR DASH BONUS GAME
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DOLLAR DASH bonus game with 10 free spins.
modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DOLLAR DASH bonus game with 10 free spins.

 This bonus maintains the mechanics of the base game and includes Reel Indicators!

 Reel Indicators are markers on each reel that show the position where a Danny symbol last landed and activated. Any new Danny symbol on the same reel cannot land higher than the marked position. If a new Danny symbol lands and activates below the marker, the marker moves downward to the new position.

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

modes.name: NO BILLS, NO THRILLS BONUS GAME
modes.trigger: Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the NO BILLS, NO THRILLS bonus game with 10 free spins.
modes.effects:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the NO BILLS, NO THRILLS bonus game with 10 free spins.

 This bonus includes all the features from the base game, and also has a Progressive Global Multiplier!

 All Dollar-Reel Multipliers are stored in a Progressive Global Multiplier that is always active and is applied to all wins!

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

ABOUT THE GAME

 Let us introduce the second half of the Cash Kings, Danny Dollar! Like his brother Donny, Danny brings a whole hatful of tricks to delight and surprise! Join us for the thrilling show with expanding Wilds, Nudge symbols, and two exciting bonus games!

 Danny Dollar is a 5-reel, 5-row game with payline wins, offering a max win of 12 500 times your bet!

 The maximum win can be reached in all game modes.
